newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to revive urea plan with new partner.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to revive urea plan with new partner.

text.p: Pequiven, Venezuela's state-owned petrochemical company, is hoping to revive plans to build a large fertilizer plant in the northern port of Jose with another partner after a first attempt fell through, a company source said on Wednesday.
Pequiven had planned to build a $700 million urea plant with U.S.-based Arcadian until the latter was taken over by Canadian fertilizer giant Potash and withdrew from the venture.
Pequiven is now considering a similar project costing between $500 and $900 million with several new partners, although the source declined to name the candidates.
